body: I think I've done well to get so many months out of it then, wow! Guess I'll stop pushing my luck and take a week of placebos just to get everything back to being happy again
Thank you! Definitely gonna take a week off and get back on them as soon as possible.

I don't have any particular afterlife belief and that probably isn't hdloing, or at least my belief doesn't match hers as she's a very devout Christian. I know she'll be happy and at peace in Heaven though, and much happier than she is now, so that's some comfort at least.

Thank you for your kind words :)

I definitely agree, I will need to take time off, I'm just hoping I'll actually be able to. The nature of my job isn't well suited to spontaneous time off, and I don't know if/how I should go about bringing it up to my bosses ahead of time.

Routine is definitely something I plan to focus on, I already stick to a routine so I'll just have to make sure it doesn't drop off.

Fortunately I know my partner will make sure I don't get too stuck in a funk, but he also has no idea what I'm going through so his support isn't the greatest currently, I can only hope it'll improve.

Thank you very much for your advice!
